additives_info.label: Food Additives
additives_info.description: Additives by class name and INS number, e.g. "Preservative (INS 211)"

addon_groups.label: Add-ons / Customisation
addon_groups.description: Customisation groups with options and prices, e.g. "Extra cheese +₹30; Choice of bread"

admission_fee.label: Admission / Registration Fee (₹)
admission_fee.description: One-time fee in addition to the recurring fee

advance_order_hours.label: Order Hours in Advance
advance_order_hours.description: Lead time needed for made-to-order items

advance_payment.label: Advance Payment (%)
advance_payment.description: Share of bill payable at booking

aerb_licence_no.label: AERB Licence No.
aerb_licence_no.description: AERB eLORA licence/registration of X-ray/CT unit (shop-level)

affiliation_number.label: Affiliation / Recognition No.
affiliation_number.description: Board affiliation no., UDISE+ code, AISHE code or university affiliation

agri_input_dealer_licence_no.label: Seed / Fertiliser / Pesticide Dealer Licence No.
agri_input_dealer_licence_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Dealer licence to sell seeds (Seeds (Control) Order 1983 cl.3), registration to sell fertilisers (FCO 1985) and licence to sell insecticides (Insecticides Act 1968 s.13).

alcohol_allowed.label: Alcohol Allowed
alcohol_allowed.description: Alcohol may be served (subject to licence)

allergens.label: Allergen Declaration
allergens.description: [LISTING] Allergen declaration, FSS L&D reg.5(14) (packaged food; online before sale). For food-service menus reg.9 (text not fully confirmed). Live catalogue key.

amfi_arn.label: AMFI ARN
amfi_arn.description: AMFI Registration Number of the mutual fund distributor

annual_energy.label: Annual Energy Consumption
annual_energy.description: kWh/year (or per cycle) from the BEE label

appliance_subtype.label: Type / Configuration
appliance_subtype.description: Sub-type within the appliance (Single Door, Front Load, Split, Inverter...)

application_area.label: Suitable For (Area)
application_area.description: Where the product is meant to be used

appointment_required.label: Appointment Required
appointment_required.description: Walk-in not accepted; book a slot

area_basis.label: Area Basis
area_basis.description: Which area the figure refers to (RERA sale is on carpet area)

arrangement.label: Arrangement
arrangement.description: Form in which flowers are sold

assembly_required.label: Assembly Required
assembly_required.description: Item is delivered knocked-down and needs assembly

authorisation_id.label: Authorised Operator ID
authorisation_id.description: Operator authorisation (CSC VLE ID, State e-Sevai centre code, UIDAI enrolment/update operator)

authorised_dealer.label: Brand-Authorised
authorised_dealer.description: Authorised dealer / service centre of the vehicle brand

available_from.label: Available From
available_from.description: Date from which the property / item is available

available_slot.label: Available During
available_slot.description: Meal-time window the item is served

awb_registration_number.label: Pet Shop Registration (AWB)
awb_registration_number.description: State Animal Welfare Board pet-shop registration number

baby_weight_range.label: Suitable Weight (kg)
baby_weight_range.description: Baby weight range the product fits

bag_size.label: Bag / Luggage Size
bag_size.description: Size class of bag or luggage

bar_council_enrolment_no.label: Bar Council Enrolment No.
bar_council_enrolment_no.description: [LISTING (permitted content) + CONDITION] Advocate enrolment number, date and State Bar Council - among the only particulars an advocate may publish online (BCI r.36 proviso); listing must not solicit (no prices-as-offers, ratings, success claims). Per advocate (store).

batch_no.label: Batch / Lot Number
batch_no.description: [LABEL-ONLY] Batch/lot number on the label (Drugs Rules r.96, MDR r.44, Cosmetics Rules r.34, FSS L&D reg.5). Expressly exempt from online pre-sale display for food (FSS L&D reg.4(5)); not required on listing for other goods. Needed on pharmacy invoices/records. Existing key.

battery_health.label: Battery Health
battery_health.description: Battery health of a used device

battery_included.label: Batteries Included
battery_included.description: Whether batteries come in the box

bedrooms.label: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Home size by BHK (property, or service pricing slab)

bee_star_rating.label: BEE Star Rating
bee_star_rating.description: [LABEL-ONLY] BEE star label mandatory on the appliance and packaging for appliances under mandatory S&L (ACs, frost-free refrigerators, ceiling fans, storage water heaters, LED lamps, TVs, etc. - list not confirmed). BEE sets no e-commerce display rule; platforms customarily show it.

best_before_date.label: Best Before Date (loose sweets)
best_before_date.description: [PREMISES] For non-packaged sweets: best-before date must be displayed on the tray/container at the outlet (FSSAI order 25-09-2020). Online display not expressly required; CP(E-Com) expiry disclosure makes it advisable. Per tray/batch (store).

bis_crs_registration_no.label: BIS CRS Registration No. (R-number)
bis_crs_registration_no.description: [LABEL-ONLY] BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme number (R-xxxxxxxx) with "Self Declaration - Conforming to IS ..." on product and packaging for notified electronics/IT goods (phones, chargers, power banks, laptops, LED lamps, UPS, CCTV etc.). No express online-display rule; a missing R-number means the model cannot lawfully be sold.

bis_jeweller_registration_no.label: BIS Jeweller Registration No.
bis_jeweller_registration_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Registration of the jeweller with BIS required to sell hallmarked gold jewellery under the 2020 Order.

bis_licence_no.label: BIS (ISI) Licence No. (CM/L)
bis_licence_no.description: [LABEL-ONLY] ISI mark licence number (CM/L-xxxxxxxxxx) and IS number for products under a Quality Control Order (toys, helmets, cement, steel, electrical wires/switches, pressure cookers, LPG stoves, packaged drinking water, many appliances...). Products without it cannot be sold, stored or displayed for sale (BIS Act 2016 s.17). Online display not expressly required.

blade_material.label: Blade / Bit Material
blade_material.description: Material of cutting blade or drill bit

blouse_fabric.label: Blouse Fabric
blouse_fabric.description: Fabric of the included blouse piece

blouse_piece.label: Blouse Piece
blouse_piece.description: Whether a blouse piece is included and how

body_measurement.label: Size in cm
body_measurement.description: Metric body/garment measurement for the size (chest, waist, foot length in cm) as LM rules require next to S/M/L

brand.label: Brand
brand.description: Brand name printed on the pack (blank for loose/unbranded goods)

brands_used.label: Products / Brands Used
brands_used.description: Product brands used in the service

brokerage.label: Brokerage
brokerage.description: Agent commission (e.g. 1 month rent, 1% of sale value, No brokerage)

burner_count.label: Burners
burner_count.description: Number of burners on a gas stove / hob

calorie_kcal_per_serving.label: Calories (kcal per serving)
calorie_kcal_per_serving.description: [LISTING, conditional] Calorific value per serving with serving size (use `portion_info`) for food service establishments holding a Central licence or with outlets at 10+ locations; reg.9(5) requires e-commerce operators to publish it. Not required for small single-outlet eateries.

capacity.label: Seats / Load Capacity
capacity.description: Seats in a vehicle, or payload of a goods vehicle (enter unit: seats or tonnes)

capacity_litres.label: Capacity (L)
capacity_litres.description: Volume capacity (backpacks, luggage, refrigerators, geysers, coolers, microwaves)

caregiver_type.label: Caregiver
caregiver_type.description: Who is deployed; each type is priced differently

certificate_provided.label: Course Certificate
certificate_provided.description: Issues training completion certificate (r.27 / ADTC certificate)

certification.label: Certificate
certification.description: Third-party certificate for stones or metal

certification_body.label: Exam / Certification Body
certification_body.description: External exam/certificate (e.g. Trinity, ABRSM, Gandharva Mahavidyalaya, NIOS)

charger_count.label: Charging Points
charger_count.description: Number of charging points / fuel dispensers

child_policy.label: Child Policy
child_policy.description: Age up to which children stay free

chit_registration_number.label: Chit Registration No.
chit_registration_number.description: Registration with State Registrar of Chits under Chit Funds Act 1982

clinical_establishment_reg_no.label: Clinical Establishment Registration No.
clinical_establishment_reg_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Registration under the Clinical Establishments Act 2010 (adopting States/UTs) or the State's own act (e.g. KPME, TN Private Clinical Establishments). CEA Rules 2012 also require rates displayed at the premises in local language and English.

closure_type.label: Closure / Fastening
closure_type.description: How the item closes or fastens

coa_registration_no.label: Council of Architecture Registration No.
coa_registration_no.description: [CONDITION] Only persons registered with the Council of Architecture may use the title "architect" (Architects Act 1972 s.37); required when the listing offers "architect" services. Per professional (store).

coaching_registration_no.label: Coaching Centre Registration No.
coaching_registration_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Registration with the local competent authority where the State has adopted the MoE Coaching Centre Guidelines 2024 (state laws, e.g. Bihar/Rajasthan, vary).

colour_code.label: Colour Code (Hex)
colour_code.description: Hex colour swatch; ONDC sends colour as hex alongside colour_name

colour_temperature.label: Light Colour
colour_temperature.description: Correlated colour temperature of lamps / lights

common_carrier_registration_no.label: Common Carrier Registration No.
common_carrier_registration_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Registration as common carrier under Carriage by Road Act 2007 s.3 for goods transport, packers & movers (and courier agencies if within the definition).

compatibility.label: Compatible With
compatibility.description: Devices/models the consumable fits (e.g. strips for Accu-Chek Active)

compatible_stove_type.label: Compatible With
compatible_stove_type.description: Cooktop / appliance the cookware works on

component_warranty.label: Component Warranty
component_warranty.description: Separate warranty on compressor/motor/panel, e.g. '10 years compressor'

composition.label: Salt / Active Composition & Strength
composition.description: [LISTING] Active ingredient(s) and strength per unit; on label under Drugs Rules r.96. CP(E-Com) r.6(5)(c) "mandatory information under applicable laws" makes it a listing item. Existing key.

consultation_mode.label: Consultation Mode
consultation_mode.description: How the service is delivered; fees often differ per mode

consumer_care_details.label: Consumer Care Details
consumer_care_details.description: [LISTING] Name/designation, address, phone and e-mail of the person to contact for consumer complaints (manufacturer/packer/importer). LM(PC) r.6(1); online via r.6(10).

cooking_medium.label: Made With
cooking_medium.description: Fat/oil used for frying/making (key for mithai and namkeen)

cooling_capacity.label: Cooling Capacity
cooling_capacity.description: AC capacity in tonnes of refrigeration

core_count.label: Number of Cores
core_count.description: Number of cores in a cable

cosmetic_licence_no.label: Cosmetic Mfg. Licence / Import Registration No.
cosmetic_licence_no.description: [LABEL-ONLY] Manufacturing licence number (domestic) or import registration certificate number (imported) under Cosmetics Rules 2020 r.34 (exact label requirement not confirmed).

count_per_kg.label: Count per kg
count_per_kg.description: Size grade for prawns/fish as count per kg, e.g. "30–40"

country_of_origin.label: Country of Origin
country_of_origin.description: [LISTING] Country of origin/manufacture/assembly. LM(PC) r.6(1) for imported packages, shown online via r.6(10); CP(E-Com) r.6(5)(d) for all goods sold on a marketplace; LM(PC) r.6(10A) (2026) requires a searchable/sortable origin filter for imported products -> filterable.

couple_friendly.label: Couple Friendly
couple_friendly.description: Unmarried couples allowed with valid ID

course.label: Course / Menu Section
course.description: Where the dish sits on the menu

coverage_sqft.label: Coverage (sq ft per unit)
coverage_sqft.description: Area covered per unit sold: paint per litre per coat, tiles per box, sheets per piece

current_rating.label: Current Rating (A)
current_rating.description: Rated current of switch, socket or MCB

curtain_heading.label: Curtain Heading
curtain_heading.description: How the curtain attaches to the rod

cylinder_test_due.label: Cylinder Test Due
cylinder_test_due.description: Quarter/year statutory re-test due marking on the cylinder (e.g. A-27)

damage_liability.label: Damage Liability Cap (₹)
damage_liability.description: Maximum renter liability for damage (insurance excess)

damage_policy.label: Damage / Loss Policy
damage_policy.description: Compensation terms for damage or loss

deity.label: Deity / Faith Figure
deity.description: Deity or figure depicted / intended for

delivery_area.label: Delivers To
delivery_area.description: Localities or radius the shop delivers goods/meals to

delivery_charge.label: Delivery Charge (₹)
delivery_charge.description: Charge to deliver/transport goods to site

design_fee.label: Design Fee (₹)
design_fee.description: Fee for design / 3D drawings, often adjusted on order

destination.label: Destination
destination.description: Places covered by the tour / ticket route

device_class.label: Device Risk Class
device_class.description: CDSCO risk class under Medical Devices Rules 2017

diameter.label: Diameter
diameter.description: Diameter / nominal size (TMT bar, pipe, screw, cookware)

diaper_size.label: Diaper Size
diaper_size.description: Diaper size with baby weight band

dietary_preference.label: Dietary Preference
dietary_preference.description: Diet suitability claims buyers filter on

dimensions.label: Size / Dimensions
dimensions.description: [LISTING] Dimensions where the commodity is sold by size (furniture, sheets, tiles, fabric lengths, appliances) - LM(PC) declaration "where relevant"; exact rule not confirmed. Existing key.

dining_capacity.label: Dining Capacity
dining_capacity.description: Guests seated at once in the dining hall

dishwasher_safe.label: Dishwasher Safe
dishwasher_safe.description: Can be washed in a dishwasher

distance_band.label: Distance
distance_band.description: Distance slab that sets the price

driver_allowance.label: Driver Allowance (₹/day)
driver_allowance.description: Daily / night allowance for driver on outstation trips

driving_range.label: Claimed Range
driving_range.description: Certified range of EV per charge

driving_school_licence_no.label: Driving School Licence No.
driving_school_licence_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Licence in Form 11 from the licensing authority for a school imparting driving instruction for hire (CMVR r.24).

drug_licence_no.label: Drug Sale Licence No.
drug_licence_no.description: [PREMISES + CONDITION, store profile] Retail (Form 20/21), wholesale (20B/21B) or homoeopathic (20C) drug sale licence of the shop; displayed at premises. Online display is in the un-notified draft e-pharmacy rules only - marketplace should still collect and show it.

drug_manufacturing_licence_no.label: Manufacturing Licence No. (Mfg. Lic. No.)
drug_manufacturing_licence_no.description: [LABEL-ONLY] Manufacturing licence number printed on drug label (Drugs Rules r.96, clause not confirmed); for imported drugs the import licence. Not required on the listing.

duration_hours.label: Duration (Hours)
duration_hours.description: Typical time for long services (bridal makeup, mehendi)

edition.label: Edition / Class
edition.description: Edition, year of revision or class (e.g. 2026-27 edition, 3rd ed.)

emergency_available.label: 24×7 / Emergency Service
emergency_available.description: Available for emergency or out-of-hours calls

emi_available.label: EMI Available
emi_available.description: Treatment can be paid in EMIs

emigration_rc_number.label: Recruiting Agent RC No.
emigration_rc_number.description: MEA eMigrate Registration Certificate number of the recruiting agent

epr_registration.label: Battery EPR Registration
epr_registration.description: Producer EPR registration number (BWMR) for batteries

expandable_storage.label: Expandable Storage
expandable_storage.description: Memory card support, e.g. 'microSD up to 1 TB'

expiry_date.label: Expiry / Use By Date
expiry_date.description: [LISTING] Expiry / use-by date of the batch in stock. CP(E-Com) r.6(5)(c) requires seller to provide expiry date for display; label: LM(PC) r.6(1) best before/use by, FSS L&D reg.5 (Use by/Expiry mandatory), Drugs Rules r.96, MDR r.44, Cosmetics Rules r.34. FSS L&D reg.4(5) alone does not require it online, but CP(E-Com) does. Food delivered must have >=30% or 45 days shelf life (FSSAI e-com direction). Existing key.

fabric_length.label: Length (m)
fabric_length.description: Length of saree, dress material or fabric piece

fabric_provided_by.label: Fabric By
fabric_provided_by.description: Customer brings fabric or tailor supplies it

fabric_width.label: Width
fabric_width.description: Width (panna) of fabric sold by the metre

fastener_grade.label: Fastener Grade
fastener_grade.description: Strength / property class of bolts and screws

fat_content.label: Fat Content
fat_content.description: Fat class of milk / dairy product

feeding_guide.label: Feeding Guide
feeding_guide.description: Daily feeding amount by body weight

festival.label: Festival
festival.description: Festival / ritual the item is for

film_certificate.label: Film Certificate
film_certificate.description: CBFC certificate of the film shown

finance_product.label: Products / Services
finance_product.description: Insurance, loan and investment products offered

floor.label: Floor
floor.description: Floor number of the unit (e.g. Ground, 3 of 12)

flow_rate.label: Flow Rate (LPM)
flow_rate.description: Water flow of tap / shower at rated pressure

follow_up_days.label: Free Follow-up Within (Days)
follow_up_days.description: Days within which a revisit is free/discounted

food_type.label: Veg / Non-Veg Mark
food_type.description: [LISTING] Green dot (veg) / brown triangle (non-veg) declaration. FSS L&D reg.5 for packaged food (shown online before sale, reg.4(5)); menus of food service establishments reg.9 (text not fully confirmed). "vegan"/"egg" are platform values, not legal marks: egg-containing food is legally non-veg. Existing key.

foreign_guests_accepted.label: Foreign Guests Accepted
foreign_guests_accepted.description: Accepts foreign nationals (property reports them under the Immigration and Foreigners Act 2025)

fortified.label: Fortified (+F)
fortified.description: Fortified with vitamins/minerals and carries the +F logo (atta, rice, oil, milk, salt)

frame_size.label: Frame Size
frame_size.description: Frame width class (or lens-bridge-temple mm, e.g. 52-18-140)

free_estimate.label: Free Diagnosis / Estimate
free_estimate.description: Diagnosis free if repair is done

frozen_dessert_type.label: Ice Cream / Frozen Dessert
frozen_dessert_type.description: Product class; FSSAI distinguishes dairy ice cream from frozen dessert

fssai_licence_no.label: FSSAI Licence No. (brand owner / manufacturer)
fssai_licence_no.description: [LISTING] 14-digit FSSAI licence/registration of the brand owner/manufacturer (and importer for imports) printed with the FSSAI logo, FSS L&D reg.5(7); online before sale (reg.4(5)).

fuel_policy.label: Fuel / Usage Policy
fuel_policy.description: Who pays fuel / how it is returned

generic.label: Common / Generic Name
generic.description: [LISTING] Common or generic name of the commodity (e.g. "Basmati Rice", "Toilet Soap"); for multi-product packs, name and number of each. LM(PC) r.6(1); online via r.6(10). Reuses live catalogue key `generic`.

generic_medicine.label: Generic Medicine
generic_medicine.description: Sold under its generic name (e.g. Jan Aushadhi) rather than a brand

govt_fee_included.label: Govt Fee Included
govt_fee_included.description: Quoted price includes the government fee

govt_schemes.label: Government Schemes
govt_schemes.description: Public schemes the establishment is empanelled for

gps_tracking.label: Live Tracking
gps_tracking.description: Live / GPS tracking of shipment or vehicle

grade.label: Grade
grade.description: Quality grade or size grade (cashew W-grades, Agmark)

grinding_charge_per_kg.label: Grinding Charge (₹/kg)
grinding_charge_per_kg.description: Job-work charge per kg for customer grain

gross_weight.label: Gross Weight (before cleaning)
gross_weight.description: Weight before cleaning/skinning; shown with net weight for meat and fish

group_booking.label: Group / Party Booking
group_booking.description: Private group or birthday party booking available

gst_rate.label: GST Rate
gst_rate.description: Applicable GST slab for the item

gstin.label: GSTIN
gstin.description: [INVOICE-ONLY + PREMISES, store profile] Seller GSTIN where registered: mandatory on tax invoice (CGST r.46) and name board (CGST r.18). Not legally required on the product listing. Composition dealers must also show "Composition taxable person".

gtin.label: Barcode (GTIN / EAN)
gtin.description: GS1 GTIN-8/13/14 of the trade item; differs per pack size

guaranteed_analysis.label: Nutritional Analysis
guaranteed_analysis.description: Declared crude protein, fat, fibre, moisture, ash (%)

hair_length.label: Hair Length
hair_length.description: Hair length band that sets price for women's cuts/colour/spa

hallmarked.label: BIS Hallmarked
hallmarked.description: [LABEL] Whether the article bears the BIS hallmark. Mandatory for gold jewellery/artefacts in notified districts (with exemptions, e.g. under 2 g); voluntary for silver. Existing key.

handloom_mark.label: Handloom Mark
handloom_mark.description: Carries Handloom Mark / India Handloom Brand

hardware_brand.label: Hardware / Fittings Brand
hardware_brand.description: Brand of hinges, channels and fittings used (Hettich, Hafele, Ebco…)

house_rules.label: House Rules
house_rules.description: Gate timing, guests, smoking, alcohol, visitors

hsn_code.label: HSN / SAC Code
hsn_code.description: [INVOICE-ONLY] HSN (goods) or SAC (services) code, 4 or 6 digits by turnover (8 for notified chemicals), required on tax invoice (CGST r.46, N.78/2020-CT). Not a listing display requirement; mostly catalogue-derived.

huid.label: HUID (Hallmark Unique ID)
huid.description: [LABEL-ONLY] 6-character alphanumeric HUID laser-marked on each hallmarked gold article (and on any hallmarked silver article from 01-09-2025); verifiable on BIS Care app. Per piece (store). Not required on the listing but strongly advisable.

icai_membership_no.label: ICAI Membership No. / Firm Reg. No.
icai_membership_no.description: [CONDITION] ICAI membership number with certificate of practice (CA Act 1949 s.6) for services reserved to chartered accountants (audit/attestation). Listing display not mandated; ICAI ethics restrict advertising.

id_proof_required.label: ID Proof / KYC Required
id_proof_required.description: Government ID / KYC needed (new SIM, connections)

imei.label: IMEI / Serial No.
imei.description: IMEI or serial of the specific unit (used/refurbished sale)

import_registration_no.label: Import Registration No.
import_registration_no.description: CDSCO registration certificate number for imported cosmetics

importer_name_address.label: Importer Name & Address
importer_name_address.description: [LISTING] For imported goods: importer name and address. LM(PC) r.6(1); CP(E-Com) r.6(5) "name and details of importer" for display.

infant_food_product.label: Infant Milk Substitute / Infant Food
infant_food_product.description: [CONDITION] Infant milk substitutes, feeding bottles and infant foods: advertising, promotion and incentives prohibited (IMS Act s.3, s.4) - no discounts/featured promotions on listing; label declarations under s.6.

ingredients.label: Ingredients
ingredients.description: [LISTING] List of ingredients in descending order incl. additives (class + INS no.). FSS L&D reg.5, online before sale (reg.4(5)); Cosmetics Rules r.34 (label).

insurance_partners.label: Insurers / TPAs Accepted
insurance_partners.description: Insurers or TPAs with cashless tie-up

interstate_allowed.label: Inter-State Travel Allowed
interstate_allowed.description: Vehicle may be taken to other states (taxes may apply)

inverter_technology.label: Inverter Technology
inverter_technology.description: Inverter compressor/motor (AC, fridge, washing machine, BLDC fan)

irdai_registration_no.label: IRDAI Registration / Licence No.
irdai_registration_no.description: [LISTING (advertisement disclosure) + CONDITION] IRDAI registration/licence no. of the agent, broker or corporate agent and the insurer name; insurance advertisements must carry registered name and registration number (IRDAI Ads & Disclosure Regs 2021 or successor).

is_standard_no.label: Indian Standard (IS) No.
is_standard_no.description: [LABEL-ONLY] Indian Standard the product is certified to, printed with the ISI mark / CRS self-declaration (e.g. IS 4151 helmets, IS 9873 toys, IS 14543 packaged drinking water).

isi_marked.label: BIS Standard (ISI) Mark
isi_marked.description: Product bears the BIS Standard Mark required by an applicable Quality Control Order

items_included.label: Items Included
items_included.description: What one meal/menu contains, e.g. "4 chapati, dal, sabzi, rice, curd"

jain_option.label: Jain Preparation Available
jain_option.description: Dish can be made Jain (no onion, garlic, root vegetables) on request

key_ingredient.label: Key Ingredients
key_ingredient.description: Headline active ingredients buyers filter on

late_fee.label: Late Return Fee
late_fee.description: Charge for late return (per hour / per day)

lead_content_declaration.label: Lead ≤ 90 ppm Declared
lead_content_declaration.description: Label declares lead content does not exceed 90 ppm

lead_time_days.label: Lead Time / Dispatch (Days)
lead_time_days.description: Days to dispatch after order confirmation

length.label: Length
length.description: Length of the item (wire coil, pipe, bar, screw)

length_of_stay_days.label: Hospital Stay (Days)
length_of_stay_days.description: Expected in-patient stay for a package

lens_power.label: Power (SPH / CYL / Axis)
lens_power.description: Lens power range or per-eye power; contact lens power is a SKU axis

licence_class.label: Licence Class
licence_class.description: Driving licence class the course trains for

licence_number.label: Licence / Registration No.
licence_number.description: Government licence or registration number for the trade (electrical contractor, pest control, tourism, IATA, etc.)

licence_required.label: Driving Licence Needed
licence_required.description: Licence class the renter must hold

live_animal.label: Live Animal / Fish
live_animal.description: Listing is a live animal, bird or fish (subject to pet-shop rules)

load_index.label: Load Index
load_index.description: Load index code on sidewall (max load per tyre)

loan_status.label: Hypothecation
loan_status.description: Whether the RC is under bank hypothecation

local_id_accepted.label: Local ID Accepted
local_id_accepted.description: Guests with ID from the same city allowed

locality.label: Locality
locality.description: Locality / project name / landmark of the property

lock_in_period.label: Lock-in Period
lock_in_period.description: Minimum tenancy before which deposit is forfeited

lock_type.label: Lock Type
lock_type.description: Locking mechanism for locks and door hardware

maintenance_included.label: Maintenance Included
maintenance_included.description: Free repair / servicing during the rental term

manufacture_month_year.label: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
manufacture_month_year.description: [LABEL-ONLY] Month and year of manufacture (or pre-packing/import). LM(PC) r.6(1). Exempt from online display under r.6(10) and FSS L&D reg.4(5); varies per batch (store).

manufacturer.label: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: [LISTING] Name of manufacturer (or packer/importer where manufacturer is not the packer). LM(PC) r.6(1); shown online via r.6(10). Existing key; extend from pharmacy to all packaged goods.

manufacturer_address.label: Manufacturer Address
manufacturer_address.description: [LISTING] Complete address of manufacturer (or packer/importer). LM(PC) r.6(1); must be shown online (r.6(10)). For food also FSS L&D reg.5 (brand owner name & address).

marketer.label: Marketed By (Name & Address)
marketer.description: Brand owner / marketer when different from manufacturer

material.label: Material
material.description: Main material (e.g. Nitrile, Latex, Aluminium, Zirconia)

max_user_weight.label: Max User Weight
max_user_weight.description: Maximum user weight for fitness machines/cycles

meals_included.label: Meals Included
meals_included.description: Meal plan included in rent / tariff

medical_device_licence_no.label: Device Manufacturing / Import Licence No.
medical_device_licence_no.description: [LABEL-ONLY] Manufacturing licence number ("Mfg. Lic. No."/"M.L.") on label of domestic medical devices (MDR r.44); import licence for imported devices.

medical_device_sale_registration_no.label: Medical Device Sale Registration No.
medical_device_sale_registration_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Registration certificate (Form MD-42) for sale/stock of medical devices under MDR 2017 as amended (rule not confirmed); pharmacies with Form 20/21 may be covered.

metal.label: Metal
metal.description: Precious or base metal of the piece

mfg_licence_no.label: Manufacturing Licence No.
mfg_licence_no.description: Drug/food/device manufacturing licence no. printed on label (Mfg. Lic. No. / M.L.)

microwave_safe.label: Microwave Safe
microwave_safe.description: Can be used in a microwave

milk_source.label: Milk Source
milk_source.description: Animal (or plant) the milk/dairy comes from

min_order_qty.label: Minimum Order
min_order_qty.description: Minimum order (e.g. 5 kg, 10 pieces) for pickup

nearby_landmark.label: Nearby Landmark
nearby_landmark.description: Distance to station / bus stand / temple / beach

net_metal_weight.label: Net Metal Weight (g)
net_metal_weight.description: Weight of precious metal excluding stones; basis of gold-rate pricing

net_quantity.label: Net Quantity
net_quantity.description: [LISTING] Net quantity in standard units (weight/volume/length/area/number). LM(PC) r.6(1); online via r.6(10); FSS L&D reg.5. Per SKU. unit_family varies by commodity (mass|volume|length|area|count).

nutrition_info.label: Nutritional Information
nutrition_info.description: [LISTING] Per 100 g/ml and per serve: energy, protein, carbohydrate, total sugars, added sugars, total & saturated fat, trans fat, sodium etc. FSS L&D reg.5 (exemptions for some foods/small packs); online before sale.

occupancy_type.label: Sharing / Occupancy
occupancy_type.description: Room sharing basis (PG) or occupancy (tour package)

oil_specification.label: Oil Specification
oil_specification.description: API / JASO / ACEA performance class, e.g. API SN, JASO MA2

old_battery_exchange.label: Old Battery Exchange
old_battery_exchange.description: Shop accepts old battery in exchange

open_days.label: Working Days
open_days.description: Days of the week open / classes held

origin.label: Origin / Region
origin.description: Region or GI origin, e.g. Nashik, Ratnagiri, Kashmir, Kerala

own_grain_grinding.label: Grinds Customer's Grain
own_grain_grinding.description: Mill accepts customer's own grain/spices for grinding (job work)

ownership_count.label: Owners
ownership_count.description: Number of previous registered owners (per VAHAN)

pack_count.label: Units in Pack
pack_count.description: Number of individual units in a multipack/combo

pack_size.label: Pack Size
pack_size.description: Pack variant as sold, e.g. "1 kg", "5 x 200 g", "Strip of 15"; the SKU-defining axis

package_includes.label: Package Includes
package_includes.description: What is included (e.g. hairstyling, draping, lashes)

package_inclusions.label: Package Inclusions
package_inclusions.description: What a treatment/surgery/health package covers (stay days, consumables, doctor fee)

packer_name_address.label: Packed / Marketed By
packer_name_address.description: [LISTING] Name and address of packer/marketer where different from manufacturer. LM(PC) r.6(1); online via r.6(10).

panel_wattage.label: Solar Panel Wattage
panel_wattage.description: Rated peak power of solar module

paper_gsm.label: Paper GSM
paper_gsm.description: Paper weight in grams per square metre

part_number.label: OEM / Part Number
part_number.description: Manufacturer or OEM part number used for exact fitment

parts_type.label: Spare Part Quality
parts_type.description: Grade of replacement part used (priced separately)

pause_days.label: Pause / Freeze Days
pause_days.description: Days the membership can be frozen

pcpndt_registration_no.label: PC&PNDT Registration No.
pcpndt_registration_no.description: [PREMISES + CONDITION, store profile] Registration under PC&PNDT Act s.18 for any centre with ultrasound/imaging capable of sex determination; certificate and "sex determination not done" notice displayed at the centre.

permit_type.label: Permit
permit_type.description: Permit under which the vehicle operates

pet_shop_registration_no.label: Pet Shop / Breeder Registration No. (SAWB)
pet_shop_registration_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Certificate of registration from the State Animal Welfare Board under the Pet Shop Rules 2018 (and Dog Breeding & Marketing Rules 2017 for breeders). Required before selling animals; display rule not confirmed.

pet_type.label: Pet
pet_type.description: Animal the product or service is for

pf_esi_compliant.label: PF / ESI Compliant
pf_esi_compliant.description: Staff covered under PF and ESI

photo_count.label: Edited Photos Delivered
photo_count.description: Number of edited photos in the package

piece_count.label: Pieces (approx.)
piece_count.description: Approximate count per unit sold, e.g. "4–5 pcs per kg", "12–16 pieces"

pieces_per_box.label: Pieces per Box
pieces_per_box.description: Number of tiles / planks per box

pitch_scale.label: Scale / Pitch
pitch_scale.description: Tuned pitch or scale (e.g. tabla C#, harmonium scale-changer, bansuri E base)

plan_period.label: Plan
plan_period.description: Billing/plan period; each period is a SKU

plant_name.label: Plant Name
plant_name.description: Common / botanical name of the plant or seed variety

ply_rating.label: Ply Rating
ply_rating.description: Ply rating of commercial / bias tyres (e.g. 14 PR)

portion_info.label: Serving Size / Portion
portion_info.description: [LISTING, conditional] Serving size accompanying the calorie declaration (FSS L&D reg.9(1)). Existing key.

portion_size.label: Portion
portion_size.description: Portion option a dish is sold in; each portion is a SKU with its own price

pot_included.label: Pot Included
pot_included.description: Plant comes with decorative pot (not nursery bag)

pot_size.label: Pot / Bag Size
pot_size.description: Diameter of pot or grow bag the plant is supplied in, or planter size

power_rating.label: Power Rating
power_rating.description: Generator kVA / amplifier watts / machine power

practitioner.label: Doctor / Practitioner
practitioner.description: Name of the doctor/therapist delivering the service

practitioner_gender.label: Practitioner Gender
practitioner_gender.description: Gender of the doctor/caregiver (buyers filter, e.g. female gynaecologist)

practitioner_registration_no.label: Practitioner Registration No. & Council
practitioner_registration_no.description: [PREMISES + prescriptions; CONDITION] Registration number and council (State Medical Council/NMC, State Dental Council, NCISM/State AYUSH board, NCH, Nursing Council, Veterinary Council, allied & healthcare council) of the practitioner offered in the listing. IMC Regs 2002 cl.1.4.1 requires display in clinic and on prescriptions/receipts; signboard/announcement content restricted (cl.7.13). Per practitioner (store).

prescription_needed_for_test.label: Doctor's Prescription Needed
prescription_needed_for_test.description: Test/scan done only on referral (e.g. ultrasound in pregnancy, CT)

prescription_required.label: Prescription Required (Rx)
prescription_required.description: [LISTING, condition of sale] Schedule H/H1/X (and NRx) drugs may be sold by retail only against a registered medical practitioner's prescription (Drugs Rules r.65/r.97). Derived from schedule_drug. Existing key.

price_basis.label: Price Basis
price_basis.description: What the listed price includes (new vehicles)

price_breakup_charges.label: Other Charges (delivery / packing / convenience)
price_breakup_charges.description: [LISTING] All compulsory and voluntary charges beyond the item price (delivery, packing, handling, convenience, visiting, taxes if extra) so the total and its break-up can be shown. CP(E-Com) r.6(5)(b). Usually a store default; per listing where it differs.

price_per_plate_non_veg.label: Non-veg Price per Plate (₹)
price_per_plate_non_veg.description: In-house non-veg menu price per plate

price_per_plate_veg.label: Veg Price per Plate (₹)
price_per_plate_veg.description: In-house veg menu price per plate

price_tiers.label: Price Tiers
price_tiers.description: Quantity slabs and unit price per slab (e.g. 1-4: ₹250, 5-9: ₹200, 10+: ₹175)

product_form.label: Form
product_form.description: Physical form of spice, pulse, dry fruit, etc.

product_range.label: Product Range
product_range.description: Brand product line, e.g. Royale, Tractor Emulsion, Weathercoat

product_type.label: Product Type
product_type.description: What the item is within the sub-category (kurta, saree, sneaker, lipstick, refrigerator, DVR...)

psara_licence_no.label: PSARA Licence No.
psara_licence_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Licence of the private security agency from the State Controlling Authority (PSARA 2005 s.4). Display rule not confirmed.

purity.label: Purity / Hallmark Grade
purity.description: [LABEL + INVOICE] Fineness grade forming part of the BIS hallmark (gold: 14/18/20/22/23/24K grades). Gold jewellery in notified districts must be hallmarked. Existing key.

qualification.label: Qualification
qualification.description: Degrees, e.g. MBBS, MD (Paediatrics), BDS, BAMS, BPT

raising_method.label: Raised / Sourced
raising_method.description: How the animal was raised or caught

rbi_registration_no.label: RBI Registration (CoR) No. of Lender
rbi_registration_no.description: [CONDITION] RBI certificate of registration of the NBFC (RBI Act s.45-IA) - and name of the bank/NBFC for which a loan agent/DSA/BC works. Display duties for lending agents under RBI digital-lending directions not confirmed.

rear_camera.label: Rear Camera
rear_camera.description: Main camera resolution(s), e.g. '50 MP + 8 MP'

recipient.label: Gift For
recipient.description: Who the gift is meant for

recommended_age.label: Recommended Age (Toys)
recommended_age.description: Manufacturer age grading for toys, e.g. '3+ years'

refund_policy.label: Refund / Exit Policy
refund_policy.description: Refund terms if the buyer leaves midway

registration_council.label: Registering Council
registration_council.description: Council that issued the registration, e.g. Tamil Nadu Medical Council, Karnataka Dental Council

rental_available.label: Available on Rent
rental_available.description: Item can also be rented (wheelchair, bed, oxygen concentrator)

rera_agent_registration_no.label: RERA Agent Registration No.
rera_agent_registration_no.description: [LISTING + CONDITION, store profile] State RERA registration of the real-estate agent (RERA s.9); agent must quote it in every sale facilitated and (state rules, e.g. Maharashtra) in all advertisements and at office. Applies to sale of plots/apartments in registrable projects.

rera_project_registration_no.label: RERA Project Registration No.
rera_project_registration_no.description: [LISTING] Project registration number (and Authority website) for any plot/apartment in a RERA-registrable project being advertised (RERA s.3, s.11(2); agents barred from facilitating unregistered projects, s.9/s.10). Per property listing (store). Not needed for resale outside a project or for rentals.

return_policy.label: Return, Refund & Cancellation Policy
return_policy.description: [LISTING] Terms of exchange, return, refund, cancellation (goods and services). CP(E-Com) r.6(5)(g) - seller must provide for display; may be a store default overridable per listing.

returnable.label: Returnable
returnable.description: Whether the item can be returned

room_type.label: Room Category
room_type.description: Room category; package prices differ by room

rto_code.label: Registration (RTO)
rto_code.description: State + RTO code of registration, e.g. KA-01

rto_dealer_authorisation_no.label: RTO Dealer Authorisation No. (pre-owned)
rto_dealer_authorisation_no.description: [CONDITION, store profile] Authorisation certificate for dealers in registered pre-owned vehicles under CMVR (2022 amendment, r.55A/55B - not confirmed); trade certificate for new-vehicle dealers.

safety_warning.label: Safety Warning
safety_warning.description: Mandatory cautionary/age warnings printed on pack (e.g. small parts – not for under 3 years)

schedule_drug.label: Drug Schedule (H / H1 / X / G / OTC)
schedule_drug.description: [LISTING + LABEL] Schedule classification driving Rx/NRx symbol and boxed warning on label (Drugs Rules r.97). Listing should show it so the Rx gate can be enforced; Schedule X and NDPS drugs should not be sold online (draft e-pharmacy rules; Delhi HC). Existing key.

season.label: Season
season.description: Season the item is made for

seating_capacity.label: Seating Capacity
seating_capacity.description: Number of people a sofa / dining set seats

sebi_registration_no.label: SEBI Registration No.
sebi_registration_no.description: [LISTING] SEBI-registered name and registration number of investment advisers, research analysts, brokers and their agents in online communications (SEBI circular Feb 2026, not confirmed).

seller_fssai_licence_no.label: Shop FSSAI Licence / Registration No.
seller_fssai_licence_no.description: [LISTING, store profile] FSSAI licence/registration of the selling food business (shop, restaurant, home kitchen, caterer). FSSAI e-commerce direction 2018 and advisory Dec 2024: platform may not list a food seller without displaying it. Also on bills/receipts (FSSAI 2025 direction, not confirmed).

seller_grievance_officer.label: Grievance Officer (name, designation, phone)
seller_grievance_officer.description: [LISTING, store profile] Name, designation and contact of the seller's grievance officer. CP(E-Com) r.6(5)(e). Collected once per shop.

seller_legal_name_address.label: Seller Legal Name & Address
seller_legal_name_address.description: [LISTING, store profile] Legal business name, whether registered, geographic address and customer-care number of the seller - marketplace must display (CP(E-Com) r.5/r.6). Collected once per shop.

serves.label: Serves (People)
serves.description: Number of people the portion serves

service_area.label: Service Area
service_area.description: Localities/radius covered for home visits, home collection or on-site service

service_days.label: Service Days
service_days.description: Days of the week the service runs

service_type.label: Service
service_type.description: The specific service offered (haircut, facial, blouse stitching, dry cleaning, screen replacement, DTH recharge...)

session_count.label: Sessions in Pack
session_count.description: Session pack size; each pack is a SKU

set_contents.label: Set Contents
set_contents.description: Pieces included in a set (kurta set, co-ord, lehenga)

setup_time_hours.label: Setup Time (Hours)
setup_time_hours.description: Hours needed to set up before the event

shade.label: Shade
shade.description: Shade name/number of makeup (lipstick, foundation, kajal colour)

shade_code.label: Shade Name / Code
shade_code.description: Manufacturer shade name / code for tinted colours

shelf_life.label: Shelf Life
shelf_life.description: Shelf life from manufacture as declared by brand, e.g. "6 months"

shelf_life_days.label: Shelf Life (Days)
shelf_life_days.description: Days the shop-made item stays good from preparation; drives best-before display

shop_establishment_reg_no.label: Shops & Establishments Registration No.
shop_establishment_reg_no.description: [PREMISES, store profile] Registration/intimation under the State Shops & Establishments Act; certificate displayed at a conspicuous place. Not a listing requirement; thresholds and exemptions vary by State.

silk_mark.label: Silk Mark Certified
silk_mark.description: Carries Silk Mark label certifying pure silk

size_chart.label: Size Chart
size_chart.description: Link or image of the brand size chart

size_system.label: Size System
size_system.description: Which size convention the size label uses

sleeve_length.label: Sleeve Length
sleeve_length.description: Sleeve length of tops, kurtas and blouses

sold_by.label: Sold By
sold_by.description: Unit in which a loose item is weighed/counted and priced; each option is a SKU

species.label: Fish / Seafood Species
species.description: Local species name, e.g. Rohu, Seer (Vanjaram), Pomfret, Tiger Prawn

sport.label: Sport
sport.description: Sport or activity the item / venue is for

sport_certification.label: Governing-body Approval
sport_certification.description: Approval/certification by a sports body (BWF, FIFA Quality, ITTF …)

standard.label: Standard Conformed
standard.description: Indian/International standard number met (IS, ISO, ASTM, DIN)

stem_count.label: Number of Stems / Flowers
stem_count.description: Flowers or stems in the arrangement

stitch_type.label: Stitching
stitch_type.description: Readymade or needs stitching (ethnic wear, dress material)

storage_instructions.label: Storage Instructions
storage_instructions.description: [LISTING for food] Storage conditions / instructions for use where the food requires it (FSS L&D reg.5, shown online before sale under reg.4(5)); [LABEL-ONLY] for drugs and devices (MDR r.44 special storage conditions).

strap_type.label: Strap Type
strap_type.description: Strap / handle type (bags) or strap type (watches)

strength.label: Strength
strength.description: Strength per unit, e.g. 500 mg, 5 mg/ml, 0.1% w/w

study_material_included.label: Study Material Included
study_material_included.description: Books / notes / kit included in fee

subscription_available.label: Daily Subscription
subscription_available.description: Can be ordered as a daily/alternate-day subscription (milk, water, tiffin)

suitable_surface.label: Suitable Surface
suitable_surface.description: Surface the coating is made for

system_of_medicine.label: System of Medicine
system_of_medicine.description: Medical system the product/service belongs to

tank_layers.label: Tank Layers
tank_layers.description: Number of layers in plastic water tanks

team_size.label: Professionals Assigned
team_size.description: Number of workers sent for the job

test_drive.label: Test Drive Available
test_drive.description: Test drive / home test drive available

tests_included.label: Tests Included
tests_included.description: Parameter list, e.g. CBC, Lipid Profile, HbA1c, TSH

tests_included_count.label: Tests / Parameters Included
tests_included_count.description: Number of tests/parameters in the test or package

theme.label: Theme / Character
theme.description: Theme or licensed character (e.g. Chhota Bheem, Spider-Man, Unicorn)

therapeutic_use.label: Used For
therapeutic_use.description: Therapeutic use / condition, e.g. fever, diabetes, BP

thickness.label: Thickness
thickness.description: Thickness of sheet, tile, mattress or cookware base

tinted_in_store.label: Machine Tinting Available
tinted_in_store.description: Shop tints the base to any shade on its tinting machine

tobacco_product.label: Tobacco Product
tobacco_product.description: [CONDITION] Tobacco item: no sale to under-18s, no sale within 100 yards of educational institutions, "sale to minors prohibited" board at point of sale (COTPA s.6); no advertisement (s.5) - online listing must not promote; packs carry pictorial warning (s.7). E-cigarettes are banned outright (PECA 2019, not cited here).

tolls_included.label: Tolls & Parking Included
tolls_included.description: Fare includes tolls, parking, state taxes

tourism_registration_number.label: Tourism Approval / Registration No.
tourism_registration_number.description: Ministry of Tourism / state tourism approval or homestay registration

trade_role.label: Business Type
trade_role.description: Seller's role in the supply chain

transport_permit_no.label: Transport Permit / Rental Licence No.
transport_permit_no.description: [CONDITION] Rent-a-Cab Scheme 1989 licence or Rent-a-Motorcycle Scheme 1997 permit (self-drive rental), or contract-carriage/goods-carriage permit (taxi, transport). Per operator or per vehicle.

travel_charge.label: Travel / Transport Charge (₹)
travel_charge.description: Charge for travel or transporting equipment outside the base area

treatments.label: Treatments / Procedures
treatments.description: Treatments or procedures the listing covers

tyre_label_rating.label: Tyre Label (RR / Wet Grip / Noise)
tyre_label_rating.description: Rolling resistance, wet grip and noise class where declared

tyre_position.label: Tyre Position
tyre_position.description: Front or rear fitment (two-wheeler tyres are axle specific)

unit_sale_price.label: Unit Sale Price
unit_sale_price.description: [LISTING] Price per standard unit (per kg/litre/metre/unit) in addition to MRP, LM(PC) 2022 amendment; derivable from mrp / net_quantity so the system should compute, not ask. MRP itself (incl. all taxes) is the `mrp` listing column.

units_per_case.label: Units per Case / Carton
units_per_case.description: Retail units in one outer case

upholstery_material.label: Upholstery
upholstery_material.description: Covering material of sofas, chairs, headboards

usage_warnings.label: Directions & Warnings
usage_warnings.description: Directions for safe use and any caution/warning on the label

vacate_hours.label: Vacate Premises (Hours)
vacate_hours.description: Hours occupants must stay out after treatment

vaccination_proof_required.label: Vaccination Proof Required
vaccination_proof_required.description: Pet must show vaccination record (boarding/grooming/day care)

variant.label: Variant / Size
variant.description: Generic variant label, e.g. paan type, menu package, treatment option

variety.label: Variety
variety.description: Cultivar/variety, e.g. Alphonso, Sona Masoori, Kashmiri Mamra, Mysore Malli

vehicle_body_type.label: Body Type
vehicle_body_type.description: Body style / size class (drives wash and rental pricing)

vehicle_class.label: Vehicle
vehicle_class.description: Class of vehicle on sale / rent

vehicle_model.label: Make & Model
vehicle_model.description: Make and model, e.g. Maruti Suzuki Swift, Honda Activa 6G

vehicle_registration_no.label: Vehicle Registration No.
vehicle_registration_no.description: [CONDITION] RC number of the specific vehicle offered (used-vehicle sale, self-drive rental, taxi). Rental/taxi vehicles must be transport-category registered. Per vehicle (store). Online display not mandated; mask on public listing.

vehicle_type.label: Vehicle
vehicle_type.description: Vehicle class the part fits / the service handles / the fleet vehicle offered

visiting_charge.label: Home Visit / Collection Charge (₹)
visiting_charge.description: Extra charge for home visit or home sample collection

volume_capacity.label: Capacity (Volume)
volume_capacity.description: Volume a container holds: water tank, pressure cooker, bottle, storage jar

warranty_days.label: Service Warranty (Days)
warranty_days.description: [LISTING] Warranty on workmanship of a service, where offered. CP(E-Com) r.6(5)(i). Existing key.

warranty_period.label: Warranty / Guarantee
warranty_period.description: [LISTING] Guarantee/warranty offered (period, by whom: manufacturer/seller). CP(E-Com) r.6(5)(i) "any relevant guarantees or warranties"; declare 0 / "No warranty" if none. Existing key (alias warranty_months).

warranty_terms.label: Warranty Terms
warranty_terms.description: What the warranty covers, e.g. '24 months free replacement + 24 months pro-rata', compressor/motor years

weight.label: Weight / Size
weight.description: Weight variant of a shop-made item, e.g. 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 2 kg cake

weight_grams.label: Gross Weight (g)
weight_grams.description: Gross weight of the piece including stones

weight_limit.label: Weight Limit
weight_limit.description: Maximum load the item supports / service accepts

weight_slab.label: Weight Slab
weight_slab.description: Shipment weight slab used for pricing

wood_type.label: Wood Type
wood_type.description: Species / core of wood or plywood
